req_statements.R1: WHEN a client requests `GET /api/system`, the system shall return `free_ram_mb` taken from `MemAvailable` in `/proc/meminfo` (converted to MB).
req_statements.R2: IF `/proc/meminfo` is missing or malformed, THEN the system shall return `free_ram_mb` as null without failing the request.
req_statements.R3: The UI top bar shall display the sum of `ram_mb` of every `up` entry and the free RAM from `/api/system`, refreshed on every poll.
req_statements.R4: WHEN any value is unavailable, the UI shall display `—` for that value.
req_statements.R5: The system summary read shall not require Docker or subprocess calls (direct file read of `/proc/meminfo`).
